TcHmi.Controls.SetDataFramework.LedVisDa.title: LED colour
TcHmi.Controls.SetDataFramework.LedVisDa.description: Grey = theme grey, always unlit. Custom = the picked custom colour.

TcHmi.Controls.SetDataFramework.LedVisDa.title: States
TcHmi.Controls.SetDataFramework.LedVisDa.description: LED states. The first one whose condition holds lights the LED; put the most severe on top.

TcHmi.Controls.SetDataFramework.LedVisDa.title: State
TcHmi.Controls.SetDataFramework.LedVisDa.description: Lights the LED while Value <sign> value.

propertiesMeta.name: value
propertiesMeta.description: Compared with the LED Value (BOOL: TRUE = 1, FALSE = 0). Can be bound to a symbol.

propertiesMeta.name: sign
propertiesMeta.description: Active while Value <sign> value, e.g. '=' with value 2: active at 2; '>' with value 80: active above 80.

propertiesMeta.name: color
propertiesMeta.description: Colour of the lit LED. Grey = unlit theme grey (no glow, no blinking). Custom = CustomColor.

propertiesMeta.name: customColor
propertiesMeta.description: Used only with Color = Custom. Core, rim and glow are worked out from it.

propertiesMeta.name: flashing
propertiesMeta.description: TRUE: the LED blinks (lit / unlit) while the state is active.
